verses.text: Mamin Jehová, te wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan a k'ayb'ub'al, malaj mach tz'alan heb' chukal.
Te wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan a kachnab'il, t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' tz'och tzak'an u'uj.
Haton heb' max k'ulanlaj chukal, heb' sk'anab'ajan sb'eyb'alan tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix ala' to tz'akan tz'aj sk'anab'ajax a cheknab'il.
Komonok aynhejoch t'a in k'o'ol in k'anab'ajan a ley.
¿Tas yuj ol in k'ixwok tato tzin k'anab'ajej masanil a cheknab'il chi'?
Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a smasanil in k'o'ol ayik toxo ix in k'ayb'ej a ley te tojol.
Ol in k'anab'ajej a ley. Manh in aktejkan t'a junelnhej. BET
¿Tas wal ol aj heb' kelemtak yik max och smul heb'? Anhej tato sk'anab'ajej a lolonel heb'.
T'a smasanil in k'ol tzin och tzak'an u'uj. Manh a cha wik'el in b'a t'a a cheknab'il.
Ix cham wal in k'ayb'an a lolonel yik wach' max och in mul t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, te wach' ach. k'ayb'ej in t'a a ley.
Ol walel masanil a ley, haton juntzanh alb'ilkan u'uj.
Ek'b'al stzalaj in k'o'ol ayik tzin k'anab'ajan in kachnab'il tzak'a' t'a yichanh pax swik'an masanil makanhil b'eyumal.
Ol in na'ub'tanhej a cheknab'il ix ak' t'ayonh. Ol cham wal in na'ub'tanhan a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ol wak' tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol yet' a cheknab'il tik, manh ol b'atkan a lolonel satk'olal wu'uj. GUÍMEL
Ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin yik wach' ol in k'anab'ajej a lolonel yakb'an pitzan hinto.
Jak in sat yik wach' snachajel a k'ayb'ub'al wu'uj, haton te satub'tak yochi.
Ek'elb'anhej wek' t'a sat lu'um tik, manh a k'ub'ejel a cheknab'il t'ayin.
Snib'ej wal in k'ol swojtakejel a ley t'a junjun rato.
Ha ach ton tza kach heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a, haton heb' katab'il yujto syik'el sb'a heb' t'a a cheknab'il.
Yujto tzin k'anab'ajej in kachnab'il tzak'a', yuj chi' kolinel t'a schukal lolonel heb' tzin patikaneli.
Wach'chom a heb' yajal smol na'ej heb' in yixtani, a inxo a chekab' in tik, a a ley ol in na'ub'tanhej.
Swak' tzalaj in k'o'ol yuj in kachnab'il, yujto syak' in razón. DÁLET
Ijan wal tzin cham swab'i, ak' in k 'inal ichataxon halani.
Ix in ch'ox chajtil in b'ey t'a ichanh, ix in a tak'wani. k'ayb'ej in t'a a b'eyb'al.
Ak' nachajel wu'uj yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il. In gana tzin na'ub'tanhej juntzanh tas ix a k'ulej to satub'tak yochi.
Ay in och t'a kusk'olal, tek'an tzin utej in k'ana' icha yaj alankani.
Ochanh wet'ok yik wach' max wesej, tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'ayin yuj a k'ayb'ub'al.
Toxo ix wak'och t'a in k'o'ol to yelnhej tas ol wala', tzin nib'ej a ley.
Mamin Jehová, te na'an in kachnab'il ix ak'a', manh in a cha k'ixwok.
Wan wak'an wip in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il yujto wan ak'an in pensar. HE
Mamin Jehová, k'ayb'ej in t'a a ley, in gana tzin k'anab'ajej masanto t'a slajwub'.
Ak' nachajel wu'uj yik wach' ol in k'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al. T'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol in gana tzin k'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al chi'.
Kuchb'ej in t'a sb'e'al a cheknab'il, yujto ay in tzalajk'olal t'ay.
Ak' in nib'ejoch in kachnab'il tzak'a, mokab' b'eyumal tzin nib'ejochi.
Manh a cha wak'och in pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios. Ak' in k 'inal, yik wach' swak'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'a in k'o'ol.
Hak'elk'och t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik, juntzanh tas alb'ilkan u'uj t'a heb' ay elk'och t'a yol sat.
Te wach' a ley t'a yol in sat, yuj chi' kolinel t'a juntzanh lolonel stzuntzankot yowal in k'o'ol, to tzin xiw t'ay.
Te xajanab'il a cheknab'il wu'uj, ak' in k 'inal, yujto tojol ach toni. VAW
Mamin Jehová, ak' a wach'k'olal yet' a kolwal t'ayin, ichataxon halani.
Icha chi' ol yal in paktzitan heb' tzin tzuntzani, yujto a a lolonel ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ochanh wet'ok yik swalel a lolonel te yel, yujto yipk'olal yaj a ley wu'uj.
In gana tzin k'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al, malajokab' b'ak'inh swaktejkani.
Junk'olal ol in ajok, yujto swak'och a ley t'a in k'o'ol.
Ha t'a yichanh heb' winh rey ol walel a cheknab'il, manh ol in k'ixwoklaj walani.
Te xajan a cheknab'il wu'uj, ay pax in tzalajk'olal yuj.
Tzin xajanej wal a cheknab'il, in gana wal yaji. Tzin te na'ub'tanhej a ley chi'. ZAÍN
Nakot tas alnakkan t'ayin, a in a chekab' in tik, a a lolonel chi' ix wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Ha lolonel chi' tz'ak'an sniwanil in k'o'ol ayik ilk'olal waji. Ha tas alnakkan chi', haton wan yak'an in k 'inal.
Ha heb' te ak'umtak, max yaktej heb' in stzuntzani, palta max waktejkanlaj a k'ayb'ub'al.
Mamin Jehová, tzin nakot juntzanh a ley aytax ek' t'a yichb'anel. Ha t'a juntzanh chi' swik' sniwanil in k'o'ol.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syaktejkan a k'ayb'ub'al heb', yuj chi' ste kot wowal.
Ha a ley ix wak'och in b'itok t'a sat lu'um tik, yujto ek'elb'anhej wek'i.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in nakot t'ak'walil, in gana tzin k'anab'ajejnhej a k'ayb'ub'al.
Sja in tzalajk'olal yujto tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il chi'. CHET
Mamin Jehová, a achnhej tzach in nib'ej. Toxo ix wak' in ti' to tzin k'anab'ajej tas tzala'.
T'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol tzin na'a to swak' tzalajb'ok a k'o'ol. Ok'ok a k'o'ol t'ayin, ichataxon alankani.
Ix in b'eytzitej in b'eyb'al, ix in yamoch in k'anab'ajan in kachnab'il tzak'a'.
T'a elanhchamel swak' wip in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal ix yak'em ya'al heb' t'a wichanh, palta max b'atlaj a k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal wu'uj.
Ha t'a chimilak'wal tzin k'e wa'an swak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yuj a ley, yujto tojol toni.
Wach' wak'an yet' heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayach yet' heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Mamin Jehová, niwan chekel a wach'k'olal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, k'ayb'ej in t'a a ley. TET
Mamin Jehová, wach' ton ix utej a k'o'ol t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik, ichataxon alankani.
In gana tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a a jelanil yet' t'a tas skojtakej, yujto a a cheknab'il swak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Ayik manto och in yahelal, manh jantakok b'aj ix in b'at t'a skal chukal, haxo tikne'ik jun, tzin k'anab'ajej a lolonel.
Ha ach tik, te wach' ach, wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej. k'ayb'ej in t'a a b'eyb'al.
Ha heb' ak'umtak, syal lolonel heb' manh yelok t'a in patik, a inxo jun, tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il t'a smasanil in k'o'ol.
Ix ixtaxel spensar heb' sk'ulan chukal, xal in jun, swak' tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Te wach' ix in elk'ochi yujto ix och in yahelal. Ichaton wal chi' ix aj in k'ayb'an a b'eyb'al.
Ha a k'ayb'ub'al t'ayin ek'b'al yelk'och t'a yichanh k'e'en tzijtumal oro yet' k'e'en plata. YOD
Ha ach ton wal ix in a b'o'o. Ak' in jelanil yik wach' tzin k'ayb'ej a cheknab'il.
Ha heb' ay elk'och t'a yol sat, tzalajokab' sk'o'ol heb' ayik tzin yilan heb' yujto a a lolonel ix wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, wojtak to te tojol a ley. Ayik tzin ak'anoch t'a ilk'olal, ayton wal yuj, yuj chi' icha chi' tzutej.
A'okab' a wach'k'olal sniwanan in k'o'ol ichataxon halan t'ayin.
Ch'ox swach'il a k'o'ol t'ayin, tzak'an pax in k 'inal. Ay wal in tzalajk'olal yuj a k'ayb'ub'al.
K'ixwokab'el heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a, yujto tzin sb'aj heb' wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'. Ha inxo tik tzin na'ub'tanhej a cheknab'il.
Ha heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, heb' ojtannak kachnab'il tzak'a', smolb'ejokab' sb'a heb' wet'ok.
Wach'okab'nhej yaj in pensar icha syal a ley, yik wach' malaj b'aj ol in k'ixwok. CAF
Toxonhej nanon yek' in k'o'ol b'ak'inh ol in a kolo', palta a a lolonel swak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Wan yixtax yol in sat yuj in maklani b'ak'inh ol elk'och tas alnakkani. Tzin na'an icha tik: ¿B'ak'inh ol ach ja ak' sniwanil in k'o'ol? xin chi.
Wach'chom manhxalaj wopisio yujto icham inxo, palta max b'atlaj a ley satk'olal wu'uj.
¿Jantakto tiempo ol wil a in a chekab' in tik? ¿B'ak'inhto wal ol ak'och syahelal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin?
Ha heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a, manh na'anok a k'ayb'ub'al yuj heb'. Toxo ix sjoy olan heb' yik tzin telwi t'ay yalan heb'.
Masanil a cheknab'il, yelnhej syala'. Ochanh wet'ok, ina to malaj in mul, palta manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Toxo ijan tzin cham yuj heb', palta max b'atlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wu'uj.
Ak' in k 'inal, icha syal jantak a wach'k'olal, icha chi' ol in k'anab'ajej in kachnab'il ix ak'a'. LAMED
Mamin Jehová, a a lolonel max k'exmajlaj. Aynhejek' t'a masanil k 'inal t'a satcha'anh.
Ha ach tik, tz'elnhejk'och tas tzal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ach a b'onak lum lum tik, yuj chi' hanheja' yaj lu'um tikne'ik.
Masanil tasi, hanheja' yaji ichataxon yaj alannakkani, hanhejtona' ha' wan a k'anan tikne'ik.
Tato maj in tzalaj in na'ub'tanhan a k'ayb'ub'al, toxom ix in lajwi'el yuj kusk'olal.
Malaj b'ak'inh sb'atkan a cheknab'il satk'olal wu'uj. Ha yuj a lolonel tik ix ak' in k 'inal.
Kolin yujto ik innhej toni, na'annhej a cheknab'il wu'uj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, wan stanhwan heb' in lajwi'eli, palta a inxo jun, a wal a kachnab'il tzala', a tzin na'ub'tanhej.
Ix wila' to malaj junok tas tz'ak'an wach'il, haxo a cheknab'il, manhxo jantakok swach'il. MEM
Te xajan a k'ayb'ub'al wu'uj. Masanil tiempo tzin na'ub'tanhej.
Na'annhej a cheknab'il wu'uj, yuj chi' yelxo wal jelan in t'a yichanh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ek'al in jelanil t'a yichanh masanil heb' in k'ayb'umal, yujto na'annhej a k'ayb'ub'al wu'uj.
Yelxo wal snachajel wu'uj t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak winak, yujto tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il.
Max yal-laj in k'ol swak'och in b'a t'a chuk b'eyb'al, yik wach' tzin k'anab'ajejnhej a lolonel.
Maj wik'el-laj in b'a t'a a k'ayb'ub'al, yujto wan in a k'ayb'ani.
Ek'b'al schi'al a lolonel t'a yichanh schi'al nok' yal chab' swab'i.
Te ay in jelanil ix wik'elta t'a a cheknab'il, yuj chi' tzin chakel masanil chuk b'eyb'al. NUN
Ha a lolonel sch'oxan wach' b'eyb'al t'ayin ichato a tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a yol in b'e, ha' sch'oxan b'e t'ayin.
Ach in Diosal, ix wak' in ti' t'ayach, yuj chi' yowalil ol in k'anab'ajej. Ol in k'ayb'ej in b'a t'a a ley to te tojol.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal ste kus in k'o'ol swab'i. Ak' in k 'inal ichataxon halani.
Mamin, cha in wach' lolonel swal t'ayach t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, tzin a k'ayb'an pax t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Junjun k'u sjawi tas ay smay t'a wib'anh, palta max b'atkanlaj a k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal wu'uj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syak'em in ya'alil heb', palta max b'atlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wu'uj.
Ha a lolonel ix al t'ayin, wiknhej yaj t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ha' tz'ak'an in tzalajk'olal.
Toxo ix wak' pensar to ol in k'anab'ajej a ley masanto t'a slajwub'. SAMEC
Tzin chakel heb' anima chab' sat, palta tzin xajanej a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ha ach ton ay ach och wenhulok yet' in kolnab'ilok. Ha a lolonel ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Elanhek t'a in tz'ey a ex tze k'ulej chukal, yujto in gana tzin k'anab'ajej scheknab'il in Diosal.
Mamin, ak' wip, ichataxon yaj alankani, yik aynhej in k 'inal. Manh ak' lajwok tas ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ochanh wet'ok, yik ol in kolchajok. Ichato chi' ol in k'anab'ajan a ley.
Ix a tek'kanem heb' syik'el sb'a t'a a ley, yujto a sjelanil heb' malaj yelk'ochi.
Icha wal k'alem, icha chi' yaj heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzin xajanej a lolonel.
Ha in niwanil tik, tz'ib'xi yuj in xiwk'olal t'ayach, yujto te niwan yelk'och a ley t'ayin. 'AYIN
Ha wach'il yet' tojolal tzin b'eyb'alej. Manh in aktejkan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ochanh wilumalok yuj in wach'ilok. Mokab' in yixtej heb' ak'umtak syutej sb'a.
Wan yixtaxel yol in sat yuj in maklan a jawi yik tzul in a kolani. Wan in tanhwan in ik'anel t'a libre ichataxon alankani.
Wach' tzutej a k'ol t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik, icha jantak a wach'k'olal. k'ayb'ej in t'a a ley.
Ak' in jelanil a in a chekab' in tik. In gana swojtakejel a kachnab'il tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, stiempo'alxo ak'an syahelal heb' sk'ulan chukal, yujto ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ek'b'al tzin nib'ej a cheknab'il t'a yichanh k'e'en oro te wach',
yuj chi' tzin k'anab'ajejnhej a cheknab'il chi', haxo pax masanil chuk b'eyb'al, tzin chakkaneli. PE
Satub'tak a kachnab'il, yuj wal chi' tzin k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Ayik tz'alchajel tas syalelk'och a lolonel, icha wal sakil k'inal yaj t'ayonh. Sk'ayb'aj heb' anima emnakil yuj.
Tzin te nib'ej wal a cheknab'il, icha wal snib'an ha ha' junok mach yuj takinhti'al.
Ilinkoti, ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin icha wal tzutej a k'ol t'a heb' tzach xajanani.
Kuchb'ej in t'a a b'eyb'al, icha wal yalan a lolonel. Manh in a cha ak'jok ganar yuj chukal.
Kolinel t'a heb' anima malaj yok'elk'olal. In gana tzin k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il.
Tzalajokab' a k'o'ol wuj a in a chekab' in tik, tzin a k'ayb'anpax t'a a ley.
Tzin te ok'i, yujto malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'a heb' wetanima'il. TZADE
Mamin Jehová, tojol ach toni, wach'nhej yelk'och a ley.
Masanil a kachnab'il, tojol toni, yuj chi' syal kak'anoch t'a ko k'o'ol.
Te taknak in k'o'ol yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto ix b'atkan a lolonel satk'olal yuj heb'.
Ha tas tzala' tz'elnhejk'ochi, yuj chi' tzin xajanej a in a chekab' in tik.
Emnakil anima in, patikab'il in el yuj heb' wetanima'il, palta max b'atkanlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wu'uj.
Ha a tojolal malaj b'ak'inh slajwi. Ha a k'ayb'ub'al yelnhej syala'.
Manhxo anima'ok waj yuj kusk'olal yet' yahelal, haxo a cheknab'il tz'ak'an in tzalajk'olal.
Ha a kachnab'il tojolnhej toni. Ak' ja in pensar yik wach' aynhej in k 'inal. COF
Mamin Jehová, t'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol tzin awaj t'ayach, tak'wej in, yujto in gana tzin k'anab'ajej a ley.
Ha t'ayach swal in b'a. Ochanh wet'ok yik wach' ol in k'anab'ajej a kachnab'il tzala'.
Ayik manto sakb'ilaj tzin k'e wa'an, tzin k'anan a kolwal yujto swak'och a lolonel yipok in k'o'ol.
Pitzan in tzek' ak'wal, tzin na'ub'tanhan tas alb'ilkan u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ab' tas swala' icha jantak a wach'k'olal. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal stojolal a b'eyb'al.
Ha heb' sna'an yak'an chukal t'ayin, ayek' heb' t'a in lak'anil, palta najat yajkan heb' t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Ha hachxo pax Mamin, te lak'an ayach ek'i, yelton wal syal masanil a cheknab'il.
Pekatax ix wojtakejel yuj a kachnab'il tik, a ach ix ak'kan t'a junelnhej. REX
Mamin, ilinkot yet' in yahelal tik, tzin a kolani yujto max b'atkan a k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal wu'uj.
Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tz'esanoch t'a wib'anh. Ak' in k 'inal ichataxon halani.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj yalan yik heb' t'a a kolwal, yujto max sk'anab'ajejlaj a cheknab'il heb'.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan tz'ok' a k'o'ol t'ayonh. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal a tojolal.
Manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin yet' heb' tzin ixtani, a inxo jun, max wik'el-laj in b'a t'a a kachnab'il.
Tzin chakel heb' tzek' yib'anh sk'ulan chukal, haton heb' max k'anab'ajan a lolonel.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal xajan a cheknab'il wu'uj. Ak' in k 'inal icha wal jantak a wach'k'olal.
Ha a lolonel te yel. Tojolton masanil a k'ayb'ub'al, malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwokelok. SIN
Wach'chom malaj in mul, tzin spech b'eyek' heb' anima niwan yopisio, palta te niwan yelk'och a lolonel t'ayin.
Stzalaj in k'o'ol yuj tas alnakkani, icha junok mach te niwan sb'eyumal syik'a'.
Max yal-laj in k'o'ol na'ojk'e lolonel, ste takkanel in k'o'ol yuj, palta tzin xajanej a k'ayb'ub'al.
T'a junjun rato swalan wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto tojol ton a ley.
Ha heb' xajanan a k'ayb'ub'al, junk'olalnhej yaj heb', malaj tas tz'ak'an telwok heb'.
Mamin Jehová, wan in tanhwan in a kolani, yujto wan in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Wan in k'anab'ajan a kachnab'il te xajan wu'uj.
Wan in k'anab'ajan a cheknab'il yet' a kachnab'il. Ojtak masanil in b'eyb'al. TAW
Mamin Jehová, k'e'okab'k'och waw t'a ichanh, ak' ja in pensar ichataxon yalan a lolonel.
Haxo in lesal jun, k'e'okab'k'och t'a ichanh, kolineli, ichataxon yaj alankani.
Swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a a b'eyb'al.
Ol in b'itej junok b'it yuj tas alnakkani, yujto masanil a cheknab'il tojol yaji.
Aynhejokab'kot b'akhan a k'ab' t'ayin yik tzin a kolani, yujto tzin te nib'ej a cheknab'il.
Mamin Jehová, snib'ej wal in k'o'ol to tzin a kolo'. Ay in tzalajk'olal t'a a k'ayb'ub'al.
Tzin nib'ej to pitzaninnhej, yik wach' ol in b'itan t'ayach. A'okab' a tojolal tz'och wet'ok.
Ix in satb'at icha nok' kalnel sakleminak yajb'ati. Kotanh, say in ek' a in a chekab' in tik, yujto max b'atlaj a cheknab'il satk'olal wu'uj.
